prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A widescreen, high-definition image set inside a classic American diner, focusing on a wall-mounted flat-screen television above a counter lined with neatly stacked white plates and glassware. The TV displays a live news broadcast, featuring a female news anchor with shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a white blouse, delivering a report with a serious expression. The news headline reads: “ON CAPITOL HILL: SHOCKING UFO TESTIMONY,” with a subheading, “FREQUENT SIGHTINGS KEPT QUIET,” and a red banner labeled “MORNING REPORT.” The TV studio background is sleek and modern, with cool blue tones, digital screens, and dynamic lighting, contrasting with the diner’s warm, slightly muted color palette of stainless steel, turquoise trim, and soft ambient light. The upper part of the image shows a classic diner menu board with faded, hard-to-read text, adding a nostalgic touch. The composition uses a shallow depth of field, keeping the TV and counter in sharp focus while the background is softly blurred, evoking a cinematic, observational style. The overall mood blends everyday Americana with a sense of intrigue and contemporary urgency, capturing the juxtaposition of ordinary life and extraordinary news.
